roles.title: Global Lead, Internal Audit
roles.location: Kenya, Uganda, Burkina Faso, United States
roles.summary: Leading the Internal Audit function at Living Goods International, an INGO operating across four countries, reporting directly to the Board Finance & Audit Committee and administratively to the Global CFO.
highlights: Designed and executed risk-based annual internal audit plans covering 4 countries, securing Board Finance & Audit Committee approval and achieving 100% plan completion on schedule.
Revised the Internal Audit Charter to full IIA standards alignment, strengthening the function's independence, mandate, and scope.

Introduced structured quarterly governance, risk, and control reporting to the Global Executive Team and Board Finance & Audit Committee, raising audit's visibility at the highest institutional levels.
Coordinated across Grants & Compliance teams, co-sourced audit partners, and external auditors to deliver a coherent combined assurance model across all operations.
Directed special audit assessments and fraud investigations, identifying root causes and implementing targeted mitigation strategies with senior stakeholders.
Repositioned Internal Audit from a compliance function into a strategic institutional partner through proactive C-suite engagement.
Applies Claude and Microsoft Copilot to strengthen audit analytics, accelerate report drafting, and enhance risk intelligence across the audit function.

concurrentInitiatives.title: AI Working Group Co-Lead
concurrentInitiatives.description: Leading the organisation's AI pilot, mobilising cross-functional teams to identify and develop institutional AI use cases, with full implementation oversight targeted for December 2026.

concurrentInitiatives.title: Budget & Strategic Planning Coordination
concurrentInitiatives.description: Coordinated the organisation's 2026 budget and strategic planning process across senior managers and C-suite leaders during the absence of a substantive Chief of Staff, ensuring structured alignment and on-schedule delivery.

roles.title: Regional Senior Auditor — Africa, Indian Subcontinent & the Arabian Peninsula
roles.location: Africa, Middle East, Asia, Europe, Americas
roles.summary: Reporting to the Global VP of Internal Audit in Geneva, delivered risk-based audit and assurance services across 25+ countries as part of SGS's global internal audit team — the world's leading inspection, verification, testing, and certification company, operating in 140+ countries.
highlights: Completed approximately 60 audit engagements over 6 years (~11/year) across Oil & Gas, Mining, Life Sciences, Logistics, Energy, Consumer Goods, Construction, and Public Sector, with 70%+ international travel across 5 continents.
Executed risk-based audits aligned with global IIA standards across multicultural, multilingual environments, on-site and remote.
Participated in the global Internal Controls Over Financial Reporting (ICOFR) review, identifying control design and implementation gaps that strengthened SGS's global financial governance framework.
Led and supported targeted fraud investigations, producing fact-based audit evidence that enabled management action and reinforced internal control culture.
Documented all audit working papers in Pentana audit management software, ensuring full quality and traceability for global audit leadership review.
Conducted post-acquisition and new-venture audits, assessing integration levels and identifying governance and value-creation opportunities across newly acquired entities.

roles.title: Chief Audit & Risk Officer
roles.summary: Reporting to the Chairman of the Board Audit & Risk Committee and the Group Managing Director, led the Internal Audit and Risk Management function across four East African markets, providing independent assurance and advisory services to multiple Board Audit & Risk Committees across the Longhorn Group.
highlights: Delivered a cost strategies audit identifying printing inefficiencies that generated significant savings (17% key cost reduction) through strategic sourcing from offshore printers, directly improving group profitability.
Cascaded the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework across all functional units and affiliates, embedding institutional risk awareness at every level of the group.
Formulated and implemented the Group Whistleblowing Policy in compliance with the Capital Markets Authority's Code of Corporate Governance Practices for Issuers of Securities, 2015.
Coordinated with the Centum Group Risk Management team and external auditors under a combined assurance model, ensuring full alignment across all three lines of assurance.
Designed and delivered risk awareness training programmes group-wide, strengthening staff understanding of internal controls and compliance obligations.

concurrentInitiatives.title: Quality Management Representative (ISO 9001)
concurrentInitiatives.description: Led a 16-member cross-business-unit team to establish, implement, and maintain the organisation's ISO 9001 QMS, successfully transitioning from ISO 9001:2008 to ISO 9001:2015 and achieving recertification on schedule.

roles.title: Regional Internal Auditor
roles.summary: Reporting to the General Manager – Audit & Risk Assurance, provided audit and risk assurance across 13 factory companies in the South Rift Region with a combined annual turnover exceeding KES 10 billion (USD 100M), reporting findings to factory board committees.
highlights: Identified CAPEX cost overruns on projects valued in excess of KES 2 billion (USD 20M) through detailed benchmarking and Bill of Quantities reviews; findings escalated to Board level.
Conducted fraud and corruption investigations within the first 6 months of appointment, identifying long-running non-compliant activities that led to fund recovery and prosecution of perpetrators.
Applied data analytics using IDEA to support risk identification, sample selection, and audit evidence generation, delivering more targeted, evidence-based audit outcomes.
Presented finalised audit reports on behalf of the KTDA Group Audit department to factory company boards and engaged with external stakeholder delegations during field assignments.

roles.title: Risk Assurance Officer
roles.summary: Reporting to the Head of Risk and Head of Internal Audit, planned and executed risk and control assessments across Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) and Personal & Business Banking (PBB) portfolios in line with approved risk methodology.
highlights: Led fraud and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) awareness training for 398 staff across all country operations, measurably strengthening compliance culture institution-wide.
Participated in pre- and post-implementation reviews of the core banking system migration from Bank Master to Temenos T24, assessing control design and implementation effectiveness.
Monitored AML, Combating Terrorism Financing (CTF), and Know-Your-Customer (KYC) compliance across the branch network, escalating control gaps to senior management.
